attributes.siem_sighting: internal SIEM look-back of the value {backend, template_id, template_version, index_patterns, window_days, count, count_capped, first_seen, last_seen, seen, queried_at, personal, line}: counts and first/last seen only, never raw events, hostnames or usernames
attributes.hash_set_hits: offline hash-set memberships of a file hash [{set, sample_sha256, signature, first_seen, file_type, mime_type, dataset, fetched_at, export_updated}]: corpus membership read from a local dataset copy (dates shown), never a verdict alone

tags.seen_in_logs: the value appears in the organisation's own telemetry (SIEM look-back over a bounded window): 'did this touch us?', a fact about our logs, not a verdict
